entities.name: Charles Leclerc
entities.description: Leclerc has a strong qualifying history in Formula One, where he holds the record for most pole positions without a World Drivers' Championship (27) and the eleventh-most in history.
Leclerc became the youngest recipient of the FIA Pole Trophy in 2019 for achieving the most pole positions.
Leclerc repeated the feat of achieving the most pole positions in 2022.

entities.name: 2019 Singapore Grand Prix
entities.description: Critics have noted his ability to outperform his machinery in qualifying conditions, which has frequently led to his one-lap pace relatively surpassing his race pace.

entities.name: Charles Leclerc at 2019 Singapore Grand Prix
entities.description: Andrew Benson of BBC Sport described his pole lap at the 2019 Singapore Grand Prix as 'one of the qualifying performances of the season'.
